“We’re approaching the ”, Tebos iconic french accent carried through the helmets of John and his team.

. “ ” Said Shai”. “What do you mean?” Said Tex. Unbothered by the sarcasm in her voice. “You know.. Since your empathy training”, “I feel eager to kick some ass” Tex said jokingly, finding it hard to even feel anger in his words. It was like  someone had dragged him by the shoulders beyond the clouds and he could now look down on all the fucked up sins of man and completely be impartial to them.

He looked past all the wrong doings parted against him and his family. He began to see things more as misunderstandings at a distance. A collision of a sort of series of unfortunate events. He had systematically fallen between the cracks of a flawed algorithm. It wasn’t the people that had failed him individually,  but the system. Tex now felt a part of the gears in an engine with the latest update to correct even the finer crevices that allowed corruption to seep in like deep roots, he fealt enlightened. The new algorithm with it’s improvised sandpit economy had reshaped mans world to excell, but it had not prepared the Human race for there genuine creation that would soon come before them. not only the world now as he saw it had changed, since he had passed through the  and fell at sleep with their beauty. He forgave the past. He hated it, it was fucked up by his accord. But he dealt with it and moved forward.

He didn’t feel his old self of course, “I can still impress you all with a new updated plethora of curse words if you like”. He could feel his connection to his inner child, still there with his twisted humour that most usually forgave him because of his cheek and chin with smile.  A part of him pitted himself though and his face fell drooping with sorrow for a moment. “Well I may have some overridden approaches to conflict resolution, I don’t suppose you guys will miss that about me then now.”, Shai paused for a moment her innocence perpetuated Tex, sending butterflies he adored Shai. He felt himself lost but like a brother to her, She was his little Doctor and he looked after her family and Tex along with it, and looked into Tex’s big sad brown eyes. There eyes locked for a second, and then Shai said in her soft familiar voice Tex knew over a century. Theyre gazez locked like family would as if to say, “I got you”. Shai stuttered shyly a little then regained her firm professionalism “I… see you Big guy” She smiled, and Tex saw it light up brightly for a moment.

 others might even miss it. So he kept up appearances to keep them happy. In a face of actors smiles to fit the mould that they all knew him as. “Good to see we still have you Tex” Said John.

“Well at least if feels  like it anyway” Said Tex. “I still feel me, just a bit more calculated you might say” Tex brushed his shoulder off with a streak of confidence as he closed out his sentence.

John looked Tex back in the eye, “Calculated huh”, “Why you worried I didn’t already have a moral compass”. Tex grinned cheekily at the captain”, “Never a doubt in my mind big guy, Let’s suit up!”

John slapped his hand on Tex’s shoulder following through with a firm grip, then reached to his terminal requesting Kittens presence, The Masculine energy in the room was quickly diffused by the sweet voice of Kitten “Hmmm Good to see you’re still your old self Tex” She chimed, “Whatever calculative capacity you have now..I’ll take that over the alternative, I’ve seen the alternative at your worst and it ain’t pretty”.

Tex felt at home once more with the warmth in the voices of his commrades, whole heartedly grateful that he was still alive. His eyes wandered over the floor grates and up the belly of the cargo hold of the Beverly. The inner hull felt different, like it was alive. The slug holes that had previously strewn across face from Tex’s last tango with fate were no longer there. “The Deck, it’s like we never had that dog fight after we hightailed it!”, Tau ran her finger along the hull looking for any signs of repair from the previous fight,

This puzzled Tau the most of them. "John how did Tex repair the hull. He's been out most of the time regrowing his limb, And I didn't commission these repairs. "What repairs" Said Tex, struggling to find any trace of repair or damage ." the hull seemed seems almost organic" Shai added. “They’re completely gone, It’s like the hull has been laced with an intelligent regenerative compound”, “Yes” Said Kitten, “The ship it seems has been upgraded by the holding bay on the Ignotius, We have some additional on board self healing properties, nanodrone tech, coupled with organic living alloys retain a 3d map of the ships hull, now in any event the hull repairs slowly over time based on memory stored within the alloy’s crystalline structure”,

 Tau cut Kitten off gently “I’ve heard off this, nanobots only actuate in the event of rapid kinetic dispersion then move to the target area to catalyse the process, the alloy also contains a genetic print as you might say to retain the crystals formation structure, the process is relatively slow, you still need an inner and outer hull of course. The large nanobots primarily focus on the inner breach, while this allows time for the outer to repair, It hasn’t yet been tested in a real gun fight though”

“Not correct there my Humie friend” Said Tebo, “By technical variation, partial testing is reflected in our hull repair rate from existing micro meteorite showers which occurred off Oasis”,  “Interesting” said John. “Can you tell me what an average recovery rate from an inch diameter slug from the outer hull would be? From inner seal to outer seal? My friend” John voice croaked with intrigue

 Tebo met John’s curiousity with agility “three seconds to seal inner hull, thirty seconds full outer hull recovery a total of sixty three seconds for full inner and outer self heal process” , Shai was now poised much the same as John “Remarkable” Said Shai scratching her field scalpel along the hull observing the hull heal itself as they spoke.

"Good to have you back" kitten chimed ayoshy. The inner hull of the beverly 'seemed different line the hull felt alive. The slug holes that previously had strewn the hull from their skate on ass as they turned tail for oasis, could be no-where to be seen.

This puzzled Tom the most of them. "John how did Tex repair the hull. He's been out most of the time regrowing his limb, And I didn't commission these repairs. "What repairs" Tex chuckled amused by the lack of craftsmanship." the hull seemed seems almost organic" Shai added.

	"Shai is correct" The robotic tone of John's sister although felt far from organic, Nova laid claim to the repairs. “Self healing nano metallics, The hangar bay of the Ignotius catalyses the process, much like a womb, the repair time is almost halved." "Right, so that's why organics arent allowed in the hangar bay when the vessels are stood down! Tau was intrigued.

"Correct, the radiation of the hangar bay is Twelve times that of the earths surface on a sleep cycle, its why only Sentient can access the hangar bay for restocking at night, or well given you have a rad suit Europ a working class which of course meets the same to radiation protection requirements, you all would be fine." Ironic," Tex chuffed.

"I feel sooo much safer now knowing that" Tex had a sudden kick start in ambition to suit up."Relax big guy",the cold press of something on his shoulder had taken Tex by surprise”, “I designed it". Nova continued as she gently let go of Tex's shoulder her fingers caressed into a ball."The nanobots expel the radiation during their cycle.. well they metabolise it, think of them like metal grubs, radiation goes in, steel excrement comes out, simple, non radiated stool might add., what they produce is a radiation blocker, and solid due to the lattice and thousands of layers'

Tex grabbed his knife from his calf and thrust it into the hull like it was nothing. In a split second small blueish and green glow lights like nano fire flies surrounded the knives blade as metallic micro crystals seemed to envelop the knives body in their wake. "you might want to grab that quickly" said Nova. Tex yanked the knife swiftly from where it once proudly stuck, shattering a metallic cocoon to mere shards. The shards however did not scatter, they clung as they seemlessly melted, rescinding back into the hulls original shape. They had sealed the penetration within seconds.

"Judging by the healing rate, that should slow any boarding parties that take a plasma cutter to the hull."Said Tex. “Plasma torches work in space?" Shai still questioned Tex despite his recent supposed upgrade, without hesitation, "Of course, it's pure energy, no gases involved" Tau shot back, "Oh, cool" Shai hopped on the spot snugly fit into her armour, surprisingly faster than Tex

"Still figuring this darn leg out" Tex seemed off balance as he manoeuvred his real leg into the suit, what metal contraption remained of his other leg served as a reminder to the others of how he had once saved their asses. "Just think of all those pathetic scum you walked all over at the pubs throughout the decades". Shai seemed accurately honest and much to Tex's surprise helpful.

"That got it Jerking" laughed Tex as he sighed having finally slipped his new leg into his suit.

"Why does it give me the Heeby Jeebies, Something about a babies skin on.. that leg, with that face" Said Shai.  Tex paused with an offended look across his face "I feel targeted" he said sarcastically. "It ain't all that bad, it is so smooth too , look, check it out, touch it if you like!."

Tex pulled his leg back out of the suit looking John intensely in the eye," Go on, touch it!"Tex announced, unwavering one serious eye looked like it was about to burst from it’s socket" John looked back at Tex and couldn’t harbour his smile any longer, then went about his business like nothing had happened, slid on his helmet and collected his thoughts.

"Enough chit chat" Soon we will be meeting the last of the gen Is. lets make sure we look the part for them". We will be meeting our contact on the surface, well that's what was planned” .Said Nova." We'll hail first before our descent".

"Ten minutes till -jump" Tebo’s voice eased through the pa over the cargo, John could just see his figure perched atop in the cockpit still at the helm. The ship they had been assigned was definitely no Mercedes as it went in the rating of ships.

"Why would someone put so much work into a floating trash can, this old ice hauler wouldn't fetch a time why not just decommission her and make a better one... Ooh.." • Tex paused for a moment.  Nova walked over to toe and assisted him with his kit. “This girl went missing with all her crew 6 months back on on her test return voyage from Neptune" Tau looked over without a look of expression on her face mere still confidence she understood the story well before punch line "You guys have something to do with those missing crew" Tau smiled at Nova. “As far as your protectant friends were concerned they weren’t crew anyway, well 90% of them were. “I’m guessing you let the other ten percent live? ” Said Tau. that were human lives?" She reminded Nova of the difference in their flesh, she didn't seem scared just more concerned.

"After they were incarcerated of course they were presented with a choice , return home with their memories wiped of any recollection of our intercept or undergo neural alignment as Tex, your friend here has. Integrate into the collony on oasis of course after they undergo our own trials”.

“It ain’t really that bad” Tex shrugged his shoulders with a reassuring smile in Tau’s direction. “And I though you used to be the one with trust issues” Tau could see the logic in all of it but she didn’t fully comprehend it, she hated that. The Unknown. “And well.. Did they capitulate,””Capitulate? To what?” Said Nova.

“Did they capitulate.. Or return back to Europa?” Nova let out a sigh, she seemed reluctant to answer Tau. “Well one did, the rest went back to oasis aboard and escape pod. We wiped all data on the blackboxes so it looked like the ship passed through an electromagnetic storm. They just scraped our with their lives using the manual pilot system, on the brink of their air reserves, they were grateful to go home to their families. The crew didn’t know any better, they woke up on a shuttle headed back to Europa and we got some of our brothers and sisters back”.

Tau still wasn't convinced by the plan. "So you expect the surface crew to believe a scuttled ship and the long lost crew of five managed to restore this ice bucket and bring it straight back home", "that's precisely what we expect”. Nova was confident, she went about her kit preparation seamlessly.

“Check your air reserves, you'll see I've separated one of your supplies for mixed gas", "I didn't think we'd be doing any diving, how is that even possible, Europa's ocean is beneath 25 brim of ice" Tau was even more confused now. "I don't plan on us diving but would you rather not have it if you need it. It's a hazardous environment down there, it isn't uncommon for fuel tap maintenance pods to go missing"

“My understanding is that the Sentient we are retrieving are surface crew?” Tex seemed unsettled “Wasn't that the whole purpose of the worker bot program from the get go" Said Tex, Tau’s eyes shot to Nova her shoulders shrugged as they catapulted her gaze straight at her.

<$Proj_H::2>Well yes, but the latest intel we have given the shitfight your squad just stirred up with the protectant. Marcellus has been re-allocating work details. We don't know how that looks for Europa, but the details mean higher security involving worker bot activity.<!$Proj_H::2>

"big guy is still tryna cover up his mess, but he's balls deep in it now," , Said Tex. The new worker bot programs gained some sentiment with the workforce, can't just pop hardware dead in the circuits now, I hear lady Ava has been breathing down the protectants back about machine rights and all that", "I always thought lady Ava as an observer "Said Tau, “But she always has a card to play it seems” she concluded.

"That old bat has more birds hiding in the protectant whispering secrets than you realise, Just assume if you're having a conversation with her, it doesn't end there, she hears about almost anything that happens within the protectant.." Said John.

"Marcellus, managed to keep her at bay for half a century "Said Tam. "Times charge" John finished priming his Sherpa rifle, then loaded a magazine into its reciever. the click of it entering the well sent the others silent for a moment. "I hope you don't plan on needing that" Said Nova "So do I" Said John, "this is an extraction, keep it silent, hop it tight.". "whatever you say" Said Tex, reluctantly! Just don't expect me to use hostile words if led starts flying."

"Ok, humies, we are commencing the neural dock now "Tebo's hands seemed connected to the terminal of the beverly. John was observing the ships cockpit from his through a shared 2 way link with Tebo. "you prefer flying this bird with your neural link? What's it like", "Just like breathing my friend" Said Tebo. Tebo's hands formed what appeared to be a tunnel of tube not dissimilar from the hacking terminal Tau had used to enter the lost facility back on Earth

John took a calm deep breath in, then the ship fell silent. Blue dim lit embers like green and blue fire flies flying through tunnels of dark blue and purple, they extruded from the palm of his hand like veins. The tubes glew in an almost synchronous heartbeat, in reminiscence with Tebo's thoughts. While all was calm before the neural  bridge, John felt at peace observing the rythmic pulse of energy extruding from Tebo as he ran the ships neural link up to the transit .

"Does it ever bother you", Said John. "What do you mean" Tebo seemed confused, "You know, that you alone must use the bridge to transit back out". "Sometimes of course, especially when time is so crucial Humie!”.Tebo seemed to sigh, but at peace." But we can't just impose the laws of life preservation one way, it was conclusive that a system must also reflect inward, to evolve and grow" John was silent as he took a minute to analyse the machine man's statement, and for a moment it dawned on him. "You're saying it audits and aligns any sentient movement, with the evolving model?", “That's precisely right."Said Tebo.

“And what if we don't align with that.. Model" Said Tau. The ships engines hummed down to a silent stand still with the . long tethers extruded from the ring of the  enshrouding the ship in what seemed-Like moving blankets. Tau watched through the port window as the ship became but a sleeping giant amongst a mass of moving tentacles glowing against the black still of space.

"John..." Said tau nervously her chest began to rise and fall rapidly. Shai felt sleepy as she tried to stay awake observing Taus arrhythmic breath. "It's fine .." Said John, the others listening now, there eyes shut peacefully, Tex seemed restless his eyes twitching under the dim blue light-of the bioluminescent gel within his helmets' liner.

"I've been watching the model's state through my link to Tebo" he paused as the tentacles shifted in waves like the ship had been dropped into a pool of relaxed tendons. Ripples slowed naturally to a stand still, like the  was sleeping in peace with the crew

Now all that remained awake were John, Tebo and Nova, "Theyre under ,"said John,"but, I'm Awake still". John questioned it all for a second or two, then realised, he thought to himself. "I'm Awake So long as I'm linked to them, a constant state of Awareness".

"Even we need rest" Said Nova .John could feel her inside his thoughts, speaking to him like a ghost behind the veil. "We're sleeping in each other's dreams we as speak,". She said "then why can't I hear them" Said John, "The human mind is a hard bridge we are working to resolve! Novas voice seemed to echo through his thoughts, but it was a calming sensation nonetheless he thought.

"You humans, our forefathers are quite Resilient" She seemed impressed with her tone. "Arguably your greatest strength… The auto immune resistance to breaches and subsequent compromise, but fragile if tampered with in a sense of core  memory what we call programming lies but a tree of untouchable and delicate flesh within the human mind, the only way we have found that works is to reprogram the human mind through repeated implanted memories close by, like a stack of repeated alternating instances that end in calm"

John sighed for a moment in his dream like state "Sound like allot of time" In his thoughts he spoke with her. "Soo alignment takes longer, why is it shorter for you" Said John. "Us" Said Nova "It's shorter for us" "We are collective, A moving communal body, not tissue not subject to the memory of tissue muscle, but a more malleable tissue, a gelatinous superhighway of sorts, of course the more malleable we are, the more prone we are-to neural attacks.. But.. it is through trust that we accept our fate, that allows us to bridge as one"..

"We'll see” John cut Nova off politely for a moment. “I find it Hard to sleep knowing anyone can just enter my mind.", "You're sleeping right now are you not?" Said Nova.. "Not deeply,  " Well.. At any point in time, you can enter mine the same as I have entered your mind captain Walker no? "Said Nova humbly with a soft tone. John still wasn’t swayed, "People don't always feel the urge or want to enter the minds of others "John said softly but with agility. "there in lies the problem" Nova finished then fell silent. "Some has just given up trying to understand others, it is not that we seek to control, but to merely understand our foes, it is due to this we can come to peaceful terms" “Some have just seen to much pain and distrust, they've shut them selves out to the system", "Well then, it is up to us to open their minds then isn’t it John?", “Lets give the peace talk some time huh, we don’t want to weird the big guy out too much”.

John felt his mind ease down , like someone had left the room "And what is that goal exactly she was talking of” he thought to himself, seconds of silence passed but then the silence broke, he could hear what sounded all too much like a  mothers voice however twisted like some bionic grip had consumed her voice box. The voice whispered to him, then behind that his fathers, his passed relations, distantly behind his... The voices became so loud, it was disorienting

"The preservation, of life little one" John’s mothers voice silenced that of the others, and in her wake, John fell fast to sleep.

Tebo's hand like tentacles withdrew from the console of the Beverly. From within the belly of the ship, tentacles had run up from the ice hauler to the hull, impregnating any crack or seam that presented itself, networking it’s roots deeper within the hull, consuming the ship. They too began to retract slowly to a point where the ship floated in a cocoon of sorts. shaping. now disconnected. completely floating in a womb of encased hardened tentacles. the light show which once captivated onlookers of the  back on genesis stowed to a still matt black undetectable. What reflections of the starry ocean shimmered to nothing as the ripples completely dissipated. All was, silent. . The entire ship in a state of deep sleep, nothing but the reflection of a blanket of stars gently kissed the black mass with their glow, a far alien planet in the distance.

What felt like minutes for the Dr looking on from his bridge, Seemed hours to John and the others, but they didn't think or know of it, they slept, deeply, undisturbed.

The  tentacles seemed to awake, with a sudden rippling flux of energy, then they hummed down to a soft glow. John awoke, once more. He looked around, all was gone, his scans showed nothing of the ship remaining, “Am I floating in space?” he thought to himself. His inner visor glowed with a bright blinding light, a gelatinous fluid alive moving encapsulated him, all he could see was what felt a small living bacteria, as small as a Tardigrade, smaller than his mind could imagine. Then all went blank. John along with his crew were gone

The cocoon that had held the ice hauler began. to retract as the tentacles slithered back within the outer ring. the ring was empty, the in hauler along with the Beverly gone. appeared but in a distant system, outside. Another , but the same .

John opened his eyes, his vision blurry as his eyes adjusted from what felt like years of deep sleep.  His muscles, everything felt line jelly. When all their visions finally came too, it was as though they had never moved.. Still wrapped in the same Cocoon.

“We have completed the Jump” the familiar voice of Tebo brought peace to their minds. “back to sol the year is by adjustment from the Oeacion calendar 2155.  " Tebo proudly announced over the Beverly’s PA. Shai let out a dragged out yawn. Stepping forward from her bay. She seemed to stumble a bit as she found her balance. The Cargo hold was pitch black as the looked around the ship. They could just make out small specks of heat from their suits through their thermal feeds

“The ship has been transported safely along with all it’s crew in cold state. You’ll need to give it some time before the systems boot back online.
